{"id": "D0LStTL0p9E", "snippet": {"title": "Sunny Balwani: The Other Theranos Conviction", "categoryId": "27", "description": "Sunny Balwani and the Theranos collapse explained from the court record: why the other Theranos conviction stuck.

Elizabeth Holmes was acquitted of defrauding patients; her former number two, Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani, was convicted on all twelve counts. An appeals court even agreed a witness at his trial gave 'actually false' testimony, and he still lost; on 5 October 2026 the Supreme Court declined to hear his case. Using the Ninth Circuit's December 2025 amended opinion, the Supreme Court docket, the US Attorney's sentencing release, the federal lab regulator's March 2016 sanctions letter and trial reporting, we follow the lab he oversaw, the patients, the pitch to investors, the two trials and the appeal. SEC claims are allegations; criminal findings are the jury's and the courts'. 'Our analysis' is labelled as our own reading.

The founder's side of the case: https://youtu.be/vdXslodih6A

{"id": "BUar6Y9qHKQ", "snippet": {"title": "Court: a witness at Sunny Balwani's trial gave false testimony. His conviction still stands. #Shorts", "categoryId": "27", "description": "Full episode ▶ https://youtu.be/D0LStTL0p9E

The Ninth Circuit accepted that investor witness Bryan Tolbert's medevac-helicopter statement at Sunny Balwani's Theranos trial was 'actually false'. It still affirmed his conviction (amended opinion, 22 Dec 2025), and the Supreme Court denied his petition on 5 Oct 2026.

Sources: US Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, United States v. Holmes / United States v. Balwani, Nos. 22-10338 & 23-1166, order denying rehearing and amended opinion (22 Dec 2025); US Supreme Court, docket No. 25-1330, Balwani v. The federal lab regulator's letter of 18 March 2016 proposing sanctions against Theranos's Newark lab was addressed to the lab director, Elizabeth Holmes and Ramesh Balwani as owners. It cited immediate jeopardy to patient health and proposed a ban of at least two years on owners and operators.
